slug: 2025-11-09 Cameroon aims to connect 328 rural communities by 2028 (PATNUC)

facts.fact: Business in Cameroon reports that the Posts and Telecommunications Minister opened bidding on 31 October 2025 for the rural connectivity component of the World Bank-backed PATNUC, funded with 55 billion XAF, to connect 328 unserved 3G localities by 2028.
